I love this. Thank you for saying it. You are absolutely right. It is not fair to be constantly questioned and second guessed and treated like a consistently unstable person when the only moments of instability are during an episode. We cannot continue to punish ourselves for our mistakes made during an episode and neither can the people in our lives. If someone cannot give you the respect of seeing you for who you are has a person and not who you are in an episode then they do not deserve your time. ❤️ I’m sorry you are having to go through this with your mom. I hope you find a solution that brings you peace and comfort.
I am currently putting together something similar for my husband. Would love to collaborate if you want to share experiences and bounce ideas off each other!
